structured_output.summary: In src/game.ts startRace(), I moved `menuTrack = track;` from straight after getTrack() to below the raceDrivers(...), createWorld(...) and carViews(...) calls, just before `race = {`. Now a call that raceDrivers rejects (carCount 7, 0, 2.5) throws before any menu state changes. state().trackId, the RACE button and the next default startRace() all keep the previous menu track. Valid starts behave exactly as before because the assignment still happens before anything reads menuTrack. New test tests/game/start-race-invalid-count.test.ts is the verifier's test plus a check that mode stays 'menu'. It failed before the fix (expected 'dust-bowl' to be 'bends') and passes after it. pnpm typecheck is clean and pnpm test passes: 77 files, 600 tests.
